prompt: Wide 3:2 frame from a phone's front camera on a selfie stick: a cartoon young woman runner with a red polka-dot bandana, hoop earrings and a white tank top, holding the selfie stick, her face and shoulders in the left and center of the frame, expression of thrilled panic: wide eyes, huge open-mouth scream that is almost a grin, hair flying. Caricature stylization: exaggerated proportions, big nose, strong chin, big expressive eyes and mouth, slightly simplified shapes, like a character from a polished animated comedy film. Behind her, in focus enough to read: a narrow sloping cobblestone street of a Mediterranean town with yellow houses and turquoise shutters, laundry lines across, a massive dark red cartoon bull charging close behind her in a dust cloud in the right half of the frame, and another runner with a selfie stick stumbling over a barrel further back. Keep the right third and the top of the frame relatively calm for composition. Stylized low-poly 3D render, soft rounded shapes, flat shading with two or three light steps, no photo textures, warm sunny palette: ochre, sand, terracotta and cream walls, turquoise and blue shutters, deep blue sky, dark cobblestones with warm highlights, deep blue shadows. Polished, juicy, cartoon-like but elegant, like a high-end animated film about a Mediterranean resort town. Absolutely no text, no letters, no UI, no overlays, no frames.
name: fakescreen-base-01
